description:
otra vez (adv.)
again , longer , once more 

This EP is about representing and celebrating Latin America's diverse music. 

With styles of music such as Bachata/Meregue, Reggaeton, Salsa, Cumbia, Samba, and Tribal-Guarachero... I want to decode the music and create these styles of music in my perspective. Mixed in with some Trap and House influences, I give praise to Latin American music with this EP.

Boricua -- Moreno -- Colombiano -- Dominicano -- Americano -- Méxicano -- Brasileiro -- Cubano


Teaser Video by Andre Power of Soulection: http://vimeo.com/51419960

Thank you for all the support!
